paper_title: New Constraints on Hidden Photons using Very High Energy Gamma-Rays from the Crab Nebula
notes: Hidden-photon (dark photon) constraint from photon->hidden-photon oscillations using VHE gamma-rays from the Crab Nebula. Combined limit converges to chi ~= 0.0343 at high mass; valid for mu <~ 10^-5 eV (coherence conditions). The bound weakens (larger chi) at lower masses; the low-mass points are approximate reads from Fig. 2. Stated confidence level is 68.3% (nearest option 0.90 selected). Values are the mixing angle chi (paper uses sin(2chi)), already dimensionless.
